objects.description: C Data Interface schema descriptor from Apache Arrow. Describes the logical type, child schemas, dictionary encoding, and holds a release callback and opaque producer data. Consumers must call release when they are responsible per Arrow C Data Interface semantics.

C Data Interface array container from Apache Arrow. Holds physical buffers, children, optional dictionary array, and a release callback with opaque producer data. Consumers follow Arrow C Data Interface semantics for releasing.

C++ container in namespace LightGBM representing a column as a list of ArrowArray chunks sharing a schema. Manages release callbacks depending on construction mode. Provides length query and a templated random-access Iterator for reading primitive values across chunks. Construction: either from a vector of ArrowArray pointers with an external schema (does not release Arrow on destruction), or from C arrays and schema (takes ownership, releases on destruction).

C++ container in namespace LightGBM representing a table composed of multiple row-chunk ArrowArray sets and a shared schema. On destruction, releases the top-level ArrowArray chunks and schema per Arrow C Data Interface consumer semantics; child arrays are released by the producer. Provides row/column counts and column accessors as ArrowChunkedArray references.

Main entry point class for LightGBM providing orchestration for training, prediction, and model conversion. It owns configuration and manages datasets, metrics, boosting, and objective function objects. Construction takes argc/argv to load parameters. Destruction behavior is not detailed here; assume standard RAII with owned unique_ptr members. Unknowns: exact semantics of LoadParameters/LoadData/Train/Predict/ConvertModel; lifecycle details of referenced types are outside this header.
Enumeration of binning modes for features: NumericalBin for continuous features binned by numeric thresholds; CategoricalBin for categorical features mapped to discrete bins.
Enumeration of missing-value handling strategies: None (no missing), Zero (treat zero as missing), NaN (treat NaN as missing).

Abstract interface representing bin data storage for one feature in original row order. Supports pushing values, subsetting, histogram construction for various integer precisions, splitting indices based on thresholds, serialization, column-wise access, and cloning. Factory methods CreateDenseBin/CreateSparseBin allocate concrete implementations.

Abstract interface for multi-valued bin storage (e.g., multi-hot features or multiple bins per row across features). Supports row/column subsetting, histogram construction with various precisions and ordered access, sparse/dense implementations, cloning, and factory methods to create appropriate concrete types.

Abstract interface for LightGBM boosting implementations. Provides lifecycle methods (initialization, training, prediction, model I/O, feature importance) and utility functions. It owns or references datasets, objectives, and metrics but does not manage their lifetime. Implementations must define all pure virtual methods. Copying is disabled.
Abstract base class extending Boosting with tree-specific accessors for getting and setting individual leaf values in trees. Implementations represent tree-based gradient boosting models.
Enumeration of supported top-level tasks for the LightGBM CLI and related entry points: training, prediction, model conversion to code, refitting existing trees, and dataset binary saving.

Configuration aggregate for LightGBM containing all tunable parameters, IO options, learning control, objective/metric/network/GPU settings, plus helpers for parsing parameter maps, alias handling, and serialization. Construct via default or from a map, then call Set() to parse/normalize parameters.
Utility struct providing a static method to rewrite a user-supplied parameter map by normalizing parameter names to their canonical aliases and logging conflicts.

Holds per-row and per-query metadata for a LightGBM Dataset, including labels, weights, query/group information, positions, and initial scores. Provides loading, partitioning, insertion, and serialization utilities. Copy operations are disabled; managed by owning Dataset instances.
Abstract interface for data parsers that convert text lines to feature/value pairs and an optional label. Includes factory methods for creating suitable parser instances based on file and options.
Singleton factory that registers and constructs Parser implementations by class name, enabling custom parsers via reflection-style registration.
Helper for static registration of custom Parser implementations into ParserFactory at construction time.

The central data container used for LightGBM training/validation. Owns feature groups, schema, metadata, and provides APIs to stream/push rows, finish building, serialize, and build training histograms. Non-copyable; typically constructed via default/size constructors and then populated through Construct/Push* or by referencing another Dataset.

LightGBM::DatasetLoader is a helper class responsible for loading and constructing Dataset objects from various sources (text files, binary files, serialized buffers, and sampled data). It encapsulates parsing, header setup, binning, feature extraction, and validation. Copy operations are disabled. Internal collaborators like Config, Dataset, Metadata, Parser, BinMapper, Random, PredictFunction are referenced but defined elsewhere.

objects.description: FeatureGroup stores and operates on a group of one or more features using LightGBM's binning representation. It owns BinMapper objects for each subfeature, manages dense/sparse bin storage (single-bin or per-subfeature multi-value bins), supports streaming insertion, subrow copying, splitting for tree algorithms, iteration over bins, and binary serialization/deserialization. Construction can be from bin mappers and row count, or from serialized memory with or without data. It manages its own Bin/BinIterator resources and offsets across subfeatures. Destruction is trivial as smart pointers manage resources. Unknowns: detailed behavior of Bin, BinMapper, BinIterator, BinaryWriter, and constants like kSparseThreshold are defined elsewhere.
Signed integer typedef used for sizes/counts in LightGBM. Underlying type is int32_t.
Numeric type for scores and gradients. Defaults to float unless SCORE_T_USE_DOUBLE is defined, in which case it is double.
Numeric type for labels and weights in metadata. Defaults to float unless LABEL_T_USE_DOUBLE is defined, in which case it is double.
Signed integer typedef used for communication sizes/counts. Underlying type is int32_t.
Callable type that performs prediction from a sparse feature vector (index, value) pairs into a single double output.
Callable type that performs prediction from a sparse feature vector into per-target sparse outputs represented as a vector of unordered_maps.
Function pointer type for reducing arrays: combines input into output given element size and array length.
Function pointer type for a reduce-scatter collective: reduces input using a provided reducer and scatters results to output blocks.
Function pointer type for an allgather collective: gathers blocks from all participants into a contiguous output buffer.

Abstract interface for evaluation metrics in LightGBM. Implementations compute metric values given predictions (optionally transformed by an ObjectiveFunction). Provides lifecycle: Init with dataset metadata and size, query names, directionality via factor_to_bigger_better, and Eval to compute values. Non-copyable, has a static factory CreateMetric to instantiate concrete metrics by name. No ownership semantics are defined here; destruction is via virtual destructor.

Static utility class for computing Discounted Cumulative Gain (DCG) and related quantities used by ranking metrics (e.g., NDCG, LambdaRank). Holds global/static label gains and position discounts initialized via Init. Provides validation helpers for metadata and labels, methods to compute DCG and Max DCG at given cutoff positions, and access to per-position discount. Not instantiable meaningfully; all operations are static.

objects.definition: class Linkers;
objects.description: Forward-declared class representing the network interface that provides send/recv functions. Only an incomplete declaration is present in this header; definition resides elsewhere.
Network structure supporting the Bruck all-gather algorithm. Tracks communication rounds (k) and per-round incoming/outgoing ranks used during all-gather.

Enumeration of node roles used by the recursive halving algorithm when machine count is not a power of two: Normal (single-node group), GroupLeader (represents a 2-node group), and Other (non-leader in a 2-node group).

Network structure for the reduce-scatter recursive halving algorithm. Encodes communication depth (k), node role, whether total machines is a power of two, an optional neighbor for pairing, and per-round peer ranks and send/recv block layout.

Static utility class providing collective communication primitives (all-reduce, all-gather, reduce-scatter) and helpers, backed by pluggable linkers and algorithm-specific maps. Holds thread-local state for rank, world size, and working buffers.

Abstract interface for LightGBM objective (loss) functions. Implementations compute gradients/hessians for training, provide metadata (name, models per iteration, etc.), optionally customize tree-leaf value renewal and output conversion, and expose factory constructors. Copying is disabled; use the static CreateObjectiveFunction factories. Many methods have default behavior; core training hooks (Init, GetGradients, GetName, ToString) are pure virtual and must be implemented by concrete objectives.

Holds configuration and callback for early stopping during prediction. It defines a FunctionType callback that decides whether to stop given the current prediction buffer and its length, and a round_period controlling how often the callback is invoked. Details beyond field semantics are not documented here.

Simple configuration struct providing parameters for constructing a PredictionEarlyStopInstance: the callback invocation period (round_period) and a margin_threshold used by certain early-stop strategies. Further behavioral details are not specified in this header.

Abstract base class in the LightGBM namespace that encapsulates subsampling/bagging strategy for training. Provides a factory (CreateSampleStrategy) and pure virtual interfaces to perform bagging, reset sampling configuration, and signal whether the Hessian changes due to sampling. Manages indices of bagged data on CPU (and optionally GPU), as well as subset usage and gradient resizing needs. Concrete strategies are defined elsewhere.

A helper/utility class that wraps a MultiValBin to build feature histograms efficiently for training. It supports subcolumn/subrow subsets, sparse/dense paths, quantized gradient histograms with 8/16/32-bit storage, and merges/moves per-thread blocks into a final buffer. Ownership: internally holds unique_ptrs to MultiValBin and its subset. Construction requires an existing MultiValBin pointer, dataset size, contained feature-group indices, and the number of gradient quantization bins.

Shared training-time state for histogram construction and data layout decisions. It stores threading parameters, bagging indices, histogram offset tables, and owns a MultiValBinWrapper to compute histograms. Provides initialization, histogram construction entry points, and CUDA row-wise data access when enabled.

Gradient-boosted decision tree model used by LightGBM. Represents a single tree that can be either standard (piecewise-constant leaves) or linear (each leaf has a linear model). Provides construction from parameters or from a serialized string, prediction, SHAP value computation, serialization (string/JSON/if-else), and utilities for shrinkage and bias. Members store tree topology, split info, leaf/internal stats, and optional linear leaf model parameters.
direct_api_constructors: LightGBM::Tree::Tree(int max_leaves, bool track_branch_features, bool is_linear)

objects.description: Abstract interface for LightGBM tree learners. Provides lifecycle hooks to initialize with training data/configuration, train a tree from gradients/hessians, refit existing trees, manage bagging subsets, and update predictions/outputs. This header defines only the interface; concrete implementations are elsewhere. Copying is disabled; destruction is via virtual destructor. Ownership/lifetime of Dataset, Tree, and ObjectiveFunction parameters is external.

functions.name: LightGBM::ArrowChunkedArray::ArrowChunkedArray
functions.description: Constructs a chunked Arrow array wrapper from an existing vector of ArrowArray chunk pointers and a single ArrowSchema shared by all chunks. The object does not take ownership of the arrays/schema for release (releases_arrow_ is false). Use when you already manage the lifetime of the underlying Arrow C Data Interface arrays.
requirements: chunks may be empty; zero-length chunks are retained as provided (no filtering performed in this overload)
schema must describe all chunks consistently; number and types of children must match the arrays (implied by Arrow C Data Interface), but exact validation is not performed here
each pointer in chunks must be a valid, initialized ArrowArray pointer for the lifetime of this ArrowChunkedArray instance
schema must remain valid and alive for the lifetime of this ArrowChunkedArray instance
callers must handle any needed release of the provided arrays and schema; this instance will not call their release callbacks

functions.name: LightGBM::ArrowChunkedArray::~ArrowChunkedArray
functions.description: Destructor for ArrowChunkedArray. If constructed with the C-array overload, calls release on each stored non-empty chunk and the schema if their release callbacks are set. If constructed from std::vector overload, performs no releases.
requirements: Do not use the object after destruction
Underlying Arrow arrays/schema must have been created following Arrow C Data Interface semantics; release callbacks must tolerate being called exactly once
If constructed with the vector overload, the caller remains responsible for releasing arrays/schema

functions.name: LightGBM::ArrowChunkedArray::get_length
functions.description: Returns the total logical length across all stored chunks. Computed once during construction via cumulative offsets; O(1) to query.
requirements: Object must have been successfully constructed
Result fits in int64_t (as tracked during construction)

functions.name: LightGBM::ArrowChunkedArray::begin
functions.description: Returns a random-access iterator to the first element of the chunked array for a given value type T. The iterator uses an internal getter to access per-chunk values.
requirements: T must be a value type compatible with the Arrow array’s physical format; specific mapping to Arrow format is defined in the corresponding implementation (unknown details)
The underlying chunked array must remain alive while iterators are in use
Dereferencing or incrementing beyond end() results in undefined behavior

functions.name: LightGBM::ArrowChunkedArray::end
functions.description: Returns a sentinel/random-access iterator one past the last element of the chunked array for a given value type T.
requirements: T must be the same type used with begin<T>() for the same traversal
The underlying chunked array must remain alive while iterators are in use
Comparing/offsetting iterators from different arrays or different T types is undefined behavior

functions.name: LightGBM::ArrowTable::ArrowTable
functions.signature: LightGBM::ArrowTable::ArrowTable(int64_t n_chunks, const ArrowArray* chunks, const ArrowSchema* schema)
functions.description: Constructs an ArrowTable from a sequence of top-level chunked record batches (or arrays) following the Arrow C Data Interface. Builds per-column ArrowChunkedArray views using each chunk’s children for each schema child. Zero-length chunks are skipped. The table assumes consumer semantics and releases the provided top-level chunks and schema in its destructor; children are not released (per spec).
requirements: n_chunks must be >= 0
chunks must point to an array of at least n_chunks ArrowArray structs representing top-level arrays (e.g., struct with children for columns)
schema must have n_children columns; for each chunk, chunks[k].children must have at least schema->n_children entries
Zero-length top-level chunks (chunks[k].length == 0) are ignored when forming columns
All non-empty chunks and schema must remain valid until the table’s destructor runs; this object will call their release callbacks if non-null
Per Arrow C Data Interface, children arrays are released by the producer; the table will not release child arrays

functions.name: LightGBM::ArrowTable::~ArrowTable
functions.description: Destructor for ArrowTable. Calls release on each provided top-level chunk (not children) and on the schema if their release callbacks are set, per Arrow C Data Interface consumer semantics.
requirements: Do not use the object after destruction
Release callbacks for top-level chunks and schema must be valid to be called at most once
Child arrays must be released by the producer per Arrow C Data Interface; this destructor will not release them

functions.name: LightGBM::ArrowTable::get_num_rows
functions.description: Returns the row count of the table as the length of the first column. Assumes all columns have equal length.
requirements: Table must contain at least one column (schema->n_children > 0)
All columns are assumed to have the same total length; no cross-check is performed

functions.name: LightGBM::ArrowTable::get_num_columns
functions.description: Returns the number of columns in the table (schema->n_children at construction time).
requirements: Table must have been successfully constructed

functions.name: LightGBM::ArrowTable::get_column
functions.description: Returns a const reference to the ArrowChunkedArray for the column at the given index.
requirements: idx must be in range [0, get_num_columns())
Returned reference is valid as long as the ArrowTable object remains alive

functions.name: LightGBM::ArrowChunkedArray::Iterator::Iterator
functions.signature:
template <typename T>
LightGBM::ArrowChunkedArray::Iterator<T>::Iterator(const LightGBM::ArrowChunkedArray& array, typename LightGBM::ArrowChunkedArray::Iterator<T>::getter_fn get, int64_t ptr_chunk)
functions.description: Constructs an iterator over a chunked array with a provided getter function to access values within a chunk. The iterator initially points to the first element of the specified chunk (ptr_chunk).
requirements: array must outlive the iterator
get must be a valid callable matching T(const ArrowArray*, int64_t) for accessing elements within a single chunk
ptr_chunk must be in range [0, number_of_chunks] for the array; exact bounds and mapping of ptr_offset are defined in the implementation (unknown details)

functions.name: LightGBM::ArrowChunkedArray::Iterator::operator*
functions.description: Dereferences the iterator to return the current value of type T at the iterator’s position across chunks.
requirements: Iterator must be valid and not at end()
Underlying chunked array and getter_fn must be valid
Behavior is undefined if the iterator points past the end or to an invalid position

functions.name: LightGBM::ArrowChunkedArray::Iterator::operator[]
functions.signature:
template <typename T>
template <typename I>
T LightGBM::ArrowChunkedArray::Iterator<T>::operator[](I idx) const
functions.description: Random-access indexing from the iterator position, returning the value at an offset idx from the iterator. Does not modify the iterator.
requirements: I must be an integer-like type convertible to int64_t
Resulting position (current + idx) must be within [begin, end) for the same container; otherwise behavior is undefined
Underlying chunked array and getter_fn must be valid

functions.name: LightGBM::ArrowChunkedArray::Iterator::operator++
functions.description: Pre-increment. Advances the iterator to the next logical element across chunks and returns a reference to itself.
requirements: Iterator must not already be at end()
Underlying chunked array must remain valid during iteration

functions.name: LightGBM::ArrowChunkedArray::Iterator::operator--
functions.description: Pre-decrement. Moves the iterator to the previous logical element across chunks and returns a reference to itself.
requirements: Iterator must not be before begin()
Underlying chunked array must remain valid during iteration

functions.name: LightGBM::ArrowChunkedArray::Iterator::operator+=
functions.description: Advances the iterator by c elements (c may be negative to move backwards) across chunks and returns a reference to itself.
requirements: Resulting position (current + c) must remain within [begin, end] for well-defined behavior
Underlying chunked array must remain valid during iteration

functions.name: LightGBM::operator-
functions.signature:
template <typename V>
int64_t LightGBM::operator-(const LightGBM::ArrowChunkedArray::Iterator<V>& a, const LightGBM::ArrowChunkedArray::Iterator<V>& b)
functions.description: Returns the distance (number of elements) between two iterators over the same ArrowChunkedArray, consistent with random-access iterator semantics.
requirements: Both iterators must be of the same template instantiation V and refer to the same underlying ArrowChunkedArray
Behavior is undefined if iterators are from different containers or different value types
Distance may be negative depending on order (a - b)

functions.name: LightGBM::Application::Application
functions.description: Constructs the main LightGBM application object that can run training, prediction, or model conversion based on command-line/config parameters. Typical usage: instantiate with the program’s argc/argv and then call Run() to execute the selected task. Details of parameter parsing and initialization are handled internally (exact steps are not shown in this header).
requirements: argc must be >= 0.
If argc > 0, argv must be a valid array of argc pointers to null-terminated C strings.
The provided arguments should be valid LightGBM command-line/config options; otherwise behavior depends on internal parsing (details not shown here).
The object must be successfully constructed before any other member function (e.g., Run) is called.

functions.name: LightGBM::Application::~Application
functions.description: Destroys the application, releasing resources such as datasets, metrics, boosting objects, and other internal state. Typically invoked automatically when the Application object goes out of scope.
requirements: The Application instance must not be used after destruction.

functions.name: LightGBM::Application::Run
functions.description: Runs the LightGBM application. Dispatches to prediction (InitPredict(); Predict()), model conversion (ConvertModel()), or training (InitTrain(); Train()) depending on config_.task. Typical usage: construct Application with argc/argv, then call Run() once to perform the requested task.
requirements: Must be called on a valid, fully constructed Application instance.
Behavior depends on config_.task being set to a supported task (kPredict, KRefitTree, kConvertModel, or training otherwise).

If task is prediction or refit, internal InitPredict must succeed before Predict; if conversion, ConvertModel is used; otherwise InitTrain must succeed before Train. The success/failure behavior is internal and not specified here.

functions.name: LightGBM::HistogramSumReducer
functions.signature: inline static void LightGBM::HistogramSumReducer(const char* src, char* dst, int type_size, comm_size_t len)
functions.description: Accumulates a contiguous buffer of histogram entries from src into dst, element-wise, using hist_t-sized additions. Intended for summing gradient/hessian histogram buffers during distributed/allreduce operations.
requirements: src must point to at least len readable bytes.
dst must point to at least len writable bytes.
type_size must equal sizeof(hist_t).
len must be a multiple of type_size.
src and dst memory regions may overlap in practice but are intended to represent corresponding histograms; callers should avoid undefined aliasing or misalignment.

functions.name: LightGBM::Int32HistogramSumReducer
functions.signature: inline static void LightGBM::Int32HistogramSumReducer(const char* src, char* dst, int type_size, comm_size_t len)
functions.description: Sums histogram buffers whose entries are stored as pairs of int32 (e.g., grad/hess) by reinterpreting them as int64 units and adding element-wise. Used to reduce int32-quantized histograms efficiently.
requirements: src must point to at least len readable bytes.
dst must point to at least len writable bytes.
type_size must equal sizeof(int32_t).
len must be a multiple of 2 * type_size (i.e., pairs of int32).
src and dst must be suitably aligned for int64_t access or at least allow safe unaligned int64 reads/writes on the target platform.
OpenMP may parallelize over the computed steps; dst must be safely writable without data races for those steps.

functions.name: LightGBM::Int16HistogramSumReducer
functions.signature: inline static void LightGBM::Int16HistogramSumReducer(const char* src, char* dst, int type_size, comm_size_t len)
functions.description: Sums histogram buffers whose entries are stored as pairs of int16 by reinterpreting them as int32 units and adding element-wise. Used to reduce int16-quantized histograms efficiently.
requirements: src must point to at least len readable bytes.
dst must point to at least len writable bytes.
type_size must equal sizeof(int16_t).
len must be a multiple of 2 * type_size (i.e., pairs of int16).
src and dst must be suitably aligned for int32_t access or at least allow safe unaligned int32 reads/writes on the target platform.
OpenMP may parallelize over the computed steps; dst must be safely writable without data races for those steps.

functions.name: LightGBM::Network::Allreduce
functions.signature: static void LightGBM::Network::Allreduce(char* input, LightGBM::comm_size_t input_size, int type_size, char* output, const LightGBM::ReduceFunction& reducer)
functions.description: Performs an all-reduce across all machines. Uses an all-gather-based algorithm for small payloads, otherwise a reduce-scatter followed by all-gather. The reduction operation is provided by reducer and must combine elements of size type_size across the cluster.
requirements: Network must be initialized before calling.
input points to a readable buffer of at least input_size bytes; may be null iff input_size == 0.
output points to a writable buffer of at least input_size bytes for the reduced result; output must be properly sized.
type_size must be a positive integer representing the byte-size of one logical element for the reducer.
reducer must be a valid function taking (const char* src, char* dst, int type_size, comm_size_t len) and performing an associative reduction in-place on dst over len bytes in increments of type_size.
input_size should be a multiple of type_size so the reducer can iterate element-wise.
Buffers must remain valid for the duration of the call.

functions.name: LightGBM::Network::AllreduceByAllGather
functions.signature: static void LightGBM::Network::AllreduceByAllGather(char* input, LightGBM::comm_size_t input_size, int type_size, char* output, const LightGBM::ReduceFunction& reducer)

requirements: Same buffer validity and sizing requirements as Network::Allreduce.
type_size must be positive; input_size should be a multiple of type_size.
Network must be initialized before calling.
reducer must be suitable for the element type and associative over the cluster.

functions.name: LightGBM::Network::Allgather
functions.signature: static void LightGBM::Network::Allgather(char* input, LightGBM::comm_size_t send_size, char* output)
functions.description: Performs an all-gather using the Bruck algorithm when all ranks contribute the same number of bytes. Each rank provides send_size bytes from input; output receives the concatenation in rank order.
requirements: Network must be initialized before calling.
input points to a readable buffer of at least send_size bytes (or may be null iff send_size == 0).
output points to a writable buffer of at least send_size * num_machines() bytes.
All ranks are expected to pass the same send_size value (as implied by the algorithm’s precondition).
Buffers must remain valid for the duration of the call.

functions.name: LightGBM::Network::Allgather
functions.signature: static void LightGBM::Network::Allgather(char* input, const LightGBM::comm_size_t* block_start, const LightGBM::comm_size_t* block_len, char* output, LightGBM::comm_size_t all_size)
functions.description: Performs an all-gather using the Bruck algorithm variant for variable-sized contributions. Each rank contributes block_len[rank] bytes starting at input; output receives all contributions arranged by the provided block_start/len layout across ranks.
requirements: Network must be initialized before calling.
block_start and block_len must point to arrays of length num_machines().
all_size must equal the sum over i of block_len[i].
input points to at least block_len[rank] bytes (or 0 if block_len[rank] == 0).
output must point to a writable buffer of at least all_size bytes.

block_start must define a non-overlapping layout consistent with block_len (i.e., block_start[0] == 0 and block_start[i] == block_start[i-1] + block_len[i-1] is a common pattern, as used elsewhere in this header).
Pointers and buffers must remain valid for the duration of the call.

functions.name: LightGBM::Network::ReduceScatter
functions.signature: static void LightGBM::Network::ReduceScatter(char* input, LightGBM::comm_size_t input_size, int type_size, const LightGBM::comm_size_t* block_start, const LightGBM::comm_size_t* block_len, char* output, LightGBM::comm_size_t output_size, const LightGBM::ReduceFunction& reducer)
functions.description: Performs a reduce-scatter across all machines using the recursive halving algorithm. The input buffer contains the concatenated data for all ranks; after reduction with reducer, each rank receives its designated segment in output.
requirements: Network must be initialized before calling.
input points to a readable buffer of at least input_size bytes.
input_size should be a multiple of type_size and typically equals the sum of block_len over all ranks times 1 element-size (as implied by layout).
block_start and block_len must point to arrays of length num_machines() describing each rank’s segment within input.
output points to a writable buffer of at least output_size bytes; typically, output_size should equal block_len[rank].
type_size must be a positive integer representing the logical element size for reduction.
reducer must be a valid associative reduction compatible with the element size, with signature like ReduceFunction (const char*, char*, int, comm_size_t).
All pointers and buffers must remain valid for the duration of the call.

functions.name: LightGBM::Network::GlobalSyncUpByMin

functions.description: Convenience template that computes the global minimum of a scalar value T across all ranks using Allreduce. Returns the reduced result.
requirements: Network must be initialized before calling.

The same T must be used consistently across all ranks.

functions.signature: template <class T> static T LightGBM::Network::GlobalSyncUpByMax(T local)
functions.description: Convenience template that computes the global maximum of a scalar value T across all ranks using Allreduce. Returns the reduced result.
requirements: Network must be initialized before calling.

functions.signature: template <class T> static T LightGBM::Network::GlobalSyncUpBySum(T local)
functions.description: Convenience template that computes the global sum of a scalar value T across all ranks using Allreduce. Returns the reduced result.
requirements: Network must be initialized before calling.

functions.name: LightGBM::Network::GlobalSyncUpByMean
functions.signature: template <class T> static T LightGBM::Network::GlobalSyncUpByMean(T local)
functions.description: Convenience template that computes the mean of a scalar value T across all ranks: it sums via GlobalSyncUpBySum and divides by the number of machines.
requirements: Network must be initialized before calling (uses internal num_machines_).
Type T must be trivially copyable and support operator + and division by an integer (num_machines).

functions.description: Element-wise sum across all ranks of a vector of T. Returns a vector of the same length containing the global sum per element, implemented via Allreduce.
requirements: Network must be initialized before calling.

functions.name: LightGBM::Network::GlobalArray

functions.description: Collects a scalar value from each rank into a vector of size num_machines(), using Allgather with equal-sized blocks. The i-th entry of the returned vector is the value from rank i.

num_rows >= 0; num_col >= 0.
parameters is an optional parameter string.
reference may be NULL; if provided, must be valid DatasetHandle to align bins.
out must be a valid pointer to receive the DatasetHandle; free with LGBM_DatasetFree.
Callback must ensure indices are within [0, num_col) and values are finite.
Returns 0 on success, -1 on failure.

functions.name: LGBM_DatasetCreateFromCSC
functions.signature: LIGHTGBM_C_EXPORT int LGBM_DatasetCreateFromCSC(const void* col_ptr, int col_ptr_type, const int32_t* indices, const void* data, int data_type, int64_t ncol_ptr, int64_t nelem, int64_t num_row, const char* parameters, const DatasetHandle reference, DatasetHandle* out)
functions.description: Creates a Dataset from a CSC sparse matrix. Optionally aligns binning with a reference dataset and accepts parameters.
requirements: col_ptr must be an array of length ncol_ptr of type per col_ptr_type (C_API_DTYPE_INT32/INT64).
indices must be an int32 array of length nelem with values in [0, num_row).
data must be an array of length nelem of type per data_type (C_API_DTYPE_FLOAT32/FLOAT64).
ncol_ptr = num_cols + 1; num_row >= 0; nelem >= 0.
parameters is an optional parameter string.
reference may be NULL; if provided, must be a valid DatasetHandle.
out must be non-NULL to receive the DatasetHandle; free with LGBM_DatasetFree.
Returns 0 on success, -1 on failure.

functions.name: LGBM_DatasetCreateFromMat
functions.signature: LIGHTGBM_C_EXPORT int LGBM_DatasetCreateFromMat(const void* data, int data_type, int32_t nrow, int32_t ncol, int is_row_major, const char* parameters, const DatasetHandle reference, DatasetHandle* out)
functions.description: Creates a Dataset from a dense matrix provided in row-major or column-major order.
requirements: data must point to a dense matrix with element type per data_type (C_API_DTYPE_FLOAT32/FLOAT64).
nrow >= 0; ncol >= 0.
is_row_major must be 1 for row-major, 0 for column-major layout.
parameters is an optional parameter string.
reference may be NULL; if provided, must be a valid DatasetHandle for bin alignment.
out must be non-NULL to receive the DatasetHandle; free with LGBM_DatasetFree.
Returns 0 on success, -1 on failure.

functions.name: LGBM_DatasetCreateFromMats
functions.signature: LIGHTGBM_C_EXPORT int LGBM_DatasetCreateFromMats(int32_t nmat, const void** data, int data_type, int32_t* nrow, int32_t ncol, int* is_row_major, const char* parameters, const DatasetHandle reference, DatasetHandle* out)
functions.description: Creates a Dataset by concatenating an array of dense matrices that may have differing row counts and layouts.
requirements: nmat >= 0; data must point to an array of nmat matrix pointers.
Each matrix uses element type per data_type (C_API_DTYPE_FLOAT32/FLOAT64).
nrow must point to an array of length nmat with row counts; each non-negative.
ncol is the number of columns for all matrices; >= 0 and consistent across matrices.
is_row_major must point to an array of length nmat with 1 (row-major) or 0 (column-major) per matrix.
parameters optional; reference optional valid DatasetHandle for bin alignment.
out must be non-NULL to receive DatasetHandle; free with LGBM_DatasetFree.
Returns 0 on success, -1 on failure.

functions.name: LGBM_DatasetCreateFromArrow
functions.signature: LIGHTGBM_C_EXPORT int LGBM_DatasetCreateFromArrow(int64_t n_chunks, const struct ArrowArray* chunks, const struct ArrowSchema* schema, const char* parameters, const DatasetHandle reference, DatasetHandle *out)
functions.description: Creates a Dataset from one or more Apache Arrow arrays with a shared schema. Useful for zero-copy or efficient ingestion from Arrow sources.
requirements: n_chunks >= 0; chunks must point to an array of ArrowArray structures of length n_chunks.
schema must describe the columns and be compatible with all chunks.
parameters optional; may control parsing and dataset options.
reference optional valid DatasetHandle for bin alignment.
out must be non-NULL to receive DatasetHandle; free with LGBM_DatasetFree.
Arrow buffers must remain valid during ingestion as required by the implementation.
Returns 0 on success, -1 on failure.

functions.name: LGBM_DatasetGetSubset
functions.signature: LIGHTGBM_C_EXPORT int LGBM_DatasetGetSubset(const DatasetHandle handle, const int32_t* used_row_indices, int32_t num_used_row_indices, const char* parameters, DatasetHandle* out)
functions.description: Creates a new Dataset that is a row-wise subset of an existing dataset using provided row indices.
requirements: handle must be a valid DatasetHandle.
used_row_indices must point to an array of length num_used_row_indices with valid row indices within the source dataset.
num_used_row_indices >= 0.
parameters optional string for subset creation.
out must be non-NULL to receive subset DatasetHandle; free with LGBM_DatasetFree.
Returns 0 on success, -1 on failure.

functions.name: LGBM_DatasetSetFeatureNames
functions.signature: LIGHTGBM_C_EXPORT int LGBM_DatasetSetFeatureNames(DatasetHandle handle, const char** feature_names, int num_feature_names)
functions.description: Sets the feature names for a dataset.
requirements: handle must be a valid DatasetHandle.
feature_names must point to an array of num_feature_names C strings (UTF-8).
num_feature_names must match the dataset’s number of features.
Call before training or validation name checks; returns 0 on success, -1 on failure.

functions.name: LGBM_DatasetGetFeatureNames
functions.signature: LIGHTGBM_C_EXPORT int LGBM_DatasetGetFeatureNames(DatasetHandle handle, const int len, int* num_feature_names, const size_t buffer_len, size_t* out_buffer_len, char** feature_names)
functions.description: Retrieves feature names from a dataset, copying up to len strings into pre-allocated char* buffers of size buffer_len each.
requirements: handle must be valid.
num_feature_names must be a valid pointer to receive total feature count.
feature_names must point to an array of len pre-allocated char* buffers; each buffer must have at least buffer_len bytes.
Content is copied up to buffer_len - 1 and null-terminated.
out_buffer_len must point to an array of len values to receive required sizes for full copies (or at least a pointer to receive sizes).
If len is smaller than the number of features, only len names are copied.
Returns 0 on success, -1 on failure.

functions.name: LGBM_DatasetFree
functions.description: Frees a Dataset and its associated resources.
requirements: handle must be a valid DatasetHandle created by LightGBM dataset creation APIs.
Do not use handle after freeing.
Returns 0 on success, -1 on failure.

functions.name: LGBM_DatasetSaveBinary
functions.signature: LIGHTGBM_C_EXPORT int LGBM_DatasetSaveBinary(DatasetHandle handle, const char* filename)
functions.description: Saves a Dataset to a LightGBM binary file for faster future loading.
requirements: handle must be valid.
filename must be a writable file path; directories must exist.
Returns 0 on success, -1 on failure.

functions.name: LGBM_DatasetSerializeReferenceToBinary
functions.signature: LIGHTGBM_C_EXPORT int LGBM_DatasetSerializeReferenceToBinary(DatasetHandle handle, ByteBufferHandle* out, int32_t* out_len)
functions.description: Serializes a Dataset’s schema (feature groups, bins, etc., excluding data) to a binary byte buffer. Use with LGBM_DatasetCreateFromSerializedReference.
requirements: handle must be a valid DatasetHandle.
out must be a non-NULL pointer to receive a ByteBufferHandle; free with LGBM_ByteBufferFree.
out_len must be a valid pointer to receive buffer size in bytes.
Returns 0 on success, -1 on failure.

functions.name: LGBM_DatasetDumpText
functions.signature: LIGHTGBM_C_EXPORT int LGBM_DatasetDumpText(DatasetHandle handle, const char* filename)
functions.description: Writes a human-readable textual dump of a dataset for debugging purposes.
requirements: handle must be valid.
filename must be a writable file path.
Intended for debugging; may be large for big datasets.
Returns 0 on success, -1 on failure.

functions.name: LGBM_DatasetSetField
functions.signature: LIGHTGBM_C_EXPORT int LGBM_DatasetSetField(DatasetHandle handle, const char* field_name, const void* field_data, int num_element, int type)
functions.description: Sets a metadata field of a Dataset such as label, weight, init_score, or group. Supports specific types per field for performance.
requirements: handle must be valid.
field_name must be one of: label, weight, init_score, group.
field_data must point to an array with num_element entries of type per 'type'.
type must be one of C_API_DTYPE_INT32, C_API_DTYPE_FLOAT32, C_API_DTYPE_FLOAT64; with restrictions: group only INT32; label/weight only FLOAT32; init_score only FLOAT64.
num_element must match expected length for the field: e.g., label/weight length equals number of data points; init_score length equals num_class * num_data (column format).
Returns 0 on success, -1 on failure.

functions.name: LGBM_DatasetSetFieldFromArrow
functions.signature: LIGHTGBM_C_EXPORT int LGBM_DatasetSetFieldFromArrow(DatasetHandle handle, const char* field_name, int64_t n_chunks, const struct ArrowArray* chunks, const struct ArrowSchema* schema)
functions.description: Sets a metadata field of a Dataset from Arrow arrays, converting types as needed (group to int32, label/weight to float32, init_score to float64).
requirements: handle must be valid.
field_name must be one of: label, weight, init_score, group.
n_chunks >= 0; chunks must point to n_chunks Arrow arrays; schema must be compatible.
The function converts the Arrow data to required target types.
Lengths must match dataset expectations (e.g., number of rows or num_class*num_data for init_score).
Returns 0 on success, -1 on failure.

functions.name: LGBM_DatasetGetField
functions.signature: LIGHTGBM_C_EXPORT int LGBM_DatasetGetField(DatasetHandle handle, const char* field_name, int* out_len, const void** out_ptr, int* out_type)
functions.description: Retrieves a metadata field from a Dataset, returning a pointer to the internal array and its length and type.
requirements: handle must be valid.
field_name must be a recognized metadata key.
out_len, out_ptr, out_type must be non-NULL pointers to receive results.
out_ptr points to internal memory owned by the dataset; treat as read-only and valid while the dataset lives or until field changes.
out_type is one of C_API_DTYPE_INT32, C_API_DTYPE_FLOAT32, C_API_DTYPE_FLOAT64.
Returns 0 on success, -1 on failure.

functions.name: LGBM_DatasetUpdateParamChecking
functions.signature: LIGHTGBM_C_EXPORT int LGBM_DatasetUpdateParamChecking(const char* old_parameters, const char* new_parameters)
functions.description: Validates updates to dataset parameters and raises errors if attempting to change parameters that cannot be updated on an existing dataset.
requirements: old_parameters and new_parameters are parameter strings; provide the current and proposed settings.
Use this before applying parameter updates to ensure they are allowed.
Returns 0 if ok, -1 if invalid changes are detected (get message via LGBM_GetLastError).

functions.name: LGBM_DatasetGetNumData
functions.signature: LIGHTGBM_C_EXPORT int LGBM_DatasetGetNumData(DatasetHandle handle, int* out)
functions.description: Returns the number of data points (rows) in a dataset.
requirements: handle must be valid.
out must be a non-NULL pointer to receive the count.
Returns 0 on success, -1 on failure.

functions.name: LGBM_DatasetGetNumFeature
functions.signature: LIGHTGBM_C_EXPORT int LGBM_DatasetGetNumFeature(DatasetHandle handle, int* out)
functions.description: Returns the number of features (columns) in a dataset.
requirements: handle must be valid.
out must be a non-NULL pointer to receive the count.
Returns 0 on success, -1 on failure.

functions.name: LGBM_DatasetGetFeatureNumBin
functions.signature: LIGHTGBM_C_EXPORT int LGBM_DatasetGetFeatureNumBin(DatasetHandle handle, int feature, int* out)
functions.description: Returns the number of bins used for a particular feature in the dataset.
requirements: handle must be valid.
feature must be a valid feature index in [0, num_features).
out must be a non-NULL pointer to receive the bin count.
Returns 0 on success, -1 on failure.

functions.name: LGBM_DatasetAddFeaturesFrom
functions.signature: LIGHTGBM_C_EXPORT int LGBM_DatasetAddFeaturesFrom(DatasetHandle target, DatasetHandle source)
functions.description: Appends features from the source dataset to the target dataset.
requirements: Both target and source must be valid DatasetHandle objects compatible for merging features.
Datasets must have compatible row counts and alignment as required by implementation.
Returns 0 on success, -1 on failure.

functions.name: LGBM_BoosterGetLinear
functions.signature: LIGHTGBM_C_EXPORT int LGBM_BoosterGetLinear(BoosterHandle handle, int* out)
functions.description: Reports whether the booster is configured to fit linear trees. Returns 1 if linear trees are used, otherwise 0.
requirements: handle must be a valid BoosterHandle.
out must be a non-NULL pointer to receive the indicator.
Returns 0 on success, -1 on failure.

functions.name: LGBM_BoosterCreate
functions.signature: LIGHTGBM_C_EXPORT int LGBM_BoosterCreate(const DatasetHandle train_data, const char* parameters, BoosterHandle* out)
functions.description: Creates a new booster (training model) with the given training dataset and parameters.
requirements: train_data must be a valid DatasetHandle.
parameters must be a parameter string in 'key=value' format; may be NULL for defaults.
out must be a non-NULL pointer to receive the BoosterHandle; free with LGBM_BoosterFree.
Returns 0 on success, -1 on failure.

functions.name: LGBM_BoosterCreateFromModelfile
functions.signature: LIGHTGBM_C_EXPORT int LGBM_BoosterCreateFromModelfile(const char* filename, int* out_num_iterations, BoosterHandle* out)
functions.description: Loads a trained booster from a model file on disk.
requirements: filename must be a readable model file path.
out_num_iterations must be a non-NULL pointer to receive the number of iterations in the model.
out must be non-NULL to receive BoosterHandle; free with LGBM_BoosterFree.
Returns 0 on success, -1 on failure.

functions.name: LGBM_BoosterLoadModelFromString
functions.signature: LIGHTGBM_C_EXPORT int LGBM_BoosterLoadModelFromString(const char* model_str, int* out_num_iterations, BoosterHandle* out)
functions.description: Loads a trained booster from an in-memory model string.
requirements: model_str must be a valid null-terminated model string.
out_num_iterations and out must be non-NULL pointers to receive results.
Free the booster with LGBM_BoosterFree when done.
Returns 0 on success, -1 on failure.

functions.name: LGBM_BoosterGetLoadedParam
functions.signature: LIGHTGBM_C_EXPORT int LGBM_BoosterGetLoadedParam(BoosterHandle handle, int64_t buffer_len, int64_t* out_len, char* out_str)
functions.description: Returns the booster’s parameters as a JSON string.
requirements: handle must be valid.
out_len must be non-NULL to receive actual string size.
out_str must have at least buffer_len bytes if buffer_len > 0; if buffer_len < *out_len, re-allocate and call again.
Returns 0 on success, -1 on failure.

functions.name: LGBM_BoosterFree
functions.description: Frees a booster and releases associated resources.
requirements: handle must be a valid BoosterHandle.
Do not use handle after freeing.
Returns 0 on success, -1 on failure.

functions.name: LGBM_BoosterShuffleModels
functions.signature: LIGHTGBM_C_EXPORT int LGBM_BoosterShuffleModels(BoosterHandle handle, int start_iter, int end_iter)
functions.description: Shuffles models (trees) between the given iteration indices within the booster. Useful for certain bagging/ordering experiments.
requirements: handle must be valid.
start_iter and end_iter define an iteration range; they must be within existing model bounds and logically ordered per implementation.
Returns 0 on success, -1 on failure.

functions.name: LGBM_BoosterMerge
functions.signature: LIGHTGBM_C_EXPORT int LGBM_BoosterMerge(BoosterHandle handle, BoosterHandle other_handle)
functions.description: Merges the model from other_handle into handle, combining boosters.
requirements: Both handle and other_handle must be valid BoosterHandles.
Models must be compatible (same feature space and parameters) as required by implementation.
After merge, other_handle remains allocated; free explicitly if no longer needed.
Returns 0 on success, -1 on failure.

functions.name: LGBM_BoosterAddValidData
functions.signature: LIGHTGBM_C_EXPORT int LGBM_BoosterAddValidData(BoosterHandle handle, const DatasetHandle valid_data)
functions.description: Adds a validation dataset to the booster for evaluation during training.
requirements: handle must be valid.
valid_data must be a valid DatasetHandle compatible with the booster’s training data (same features and names).
Returns 0 on success, -1 on failure.

functions.name: LGBM_BoosterResetTrainingData
functions.signature: LIGHTGBM_C_EXPORT int LGBM_BoosterResetTrainingData(BoosterHandle handle, const DatasetHandle train_data)
functions.description: Resets/replaces the training dataset used by the booster.
requirements: handle must be valid.
train_data must be a valid DatasetHandle compatible with the booster configuration.
Returns 0 on success, -1 on failure.

functions.name: LGBM_BoosterResetParameter
functions.signature: LIGHTGBM_C_EXPORT int LGBM_BoosterResetParameter(BoosterHandle handle, const char* parameters)
functions.description: Applies new parameters to an existing booster.
requirements: handle must be valid.
parameters must be a parameter string; only parameters allowed to change at runtime will take effect.
Returns 0 on success, -1 on failure.

functions.name: LGBM_BoosterGetNumClasses
functions.signature: LIGHTGBM_C_EXPORT int LGBM_BoosterGetNumClasses(BoosterHandle handle, int* out_len)
functions.description: Returns the number of classes the model is configured for (1 for binary/regression, >1 for multiclass).
requirements: handle must be valid.
out_len must be non-NULL.
Returns 0 on success, -1 on failure.

functions.name: LGBM_BoosterUpdateOneIter
functions.signature: LIGHTGBM_C_EXPORT int LGBM_BoosterUpdateOneIter(BoosterHandle handle, int* produced_empty_tree)
functions.description: Advances training by one iteration, updating the model. Reports if the tree(s) built in this iteration had no splits (produced_empty_tree=1), which may indicate convergence depending on randomness.
requirements: handle must be valid and created for training with training data.
produced_empty_tree must be a non-NULL pointer to receive the flag.
Returns 0 on success, -1 on failure.

functions.name: LGBM_BoosterRefit
functions.signature: LIGHTGBM_C_EXPORT int LGBM_BoosterRefit(BoosterHandle handle, const int32_t* leaf_preds, int32_t nrow, int32_t ncol)
functions.description: Refits the existing tree model using new data via specified predicted leaf indices (online learning).
requirements: handle must be valid.
leaf_preds must point to an array with nrow*ncol int32 entries representing predicted leaf indices.
nrow >= 0; ncol >= 0.
Indices must be valid for the existing model’s leaves; otherwise behavior is undefined/failure.
Returns 0 on success, -1 on failure.

functions.name: LGBM_BoosterUpdateOneIterCustom
functions.signature: LIGHTGBM_C_EXPORT int LGBM_BoosterUpdateOneIterCustom(BoosterHandle handle, const float* grad, const float* hess, int* produced_empty_tree)
functions.description: Performs one training iteration using user-supplied gradients and Hessians (for custom loss). Reports if the resulting tree(s) had no splits.
requirements: handle must be a valid booster with training data.
grad and hess must each point to arrays of length num_class * num_train_data; the library does not verify lengths (caller must ensure).
produced_empty_tree must be a non-NULL pointer to receive the flag.
Returns 0 on success, -1 on failure.

functions.name: LGBM_BoosterRollbackOneIter
functions.description: Rolls back the most recent iteration from the model, removing the last added trees.
requirements: handle must be valid and have at least one iteration to roll back.
Returns 0 on success, -1 on failure.

functions.name: LGBM_BoosterGetCurrentIteration
functions.description: Returns the current boosting iteration index.
requirements: handle must be valid.
out_iteration must be non-NULL.
Returns 0 on success, -1 on failure.

functions.name: LGBM_BoosterNumModelPerIteration
functions.description: Returns the number of trees (weak models) built per iteration (e.g., num_classes for multiclass).
requirements: handle must be valid.
out_tree_per_iteration must be non-NULL.
Returns 0 on success, -1 on failure.

functions.name: LGBM_BoosterNumberOfTotalModel
functions.description: Returns the total number of weak models (trees) in the booster.
requirements: handle must be valid.
out_models must be non-NULL.
Returns 0 on success, -1 on failure.

functions.name: LGBM_BoosterGetEvalCounts
functions.signature: LIGHTGBM_C_EXPORT int LGBM_BoosterGetEvalCounts(BoosterHandle handle, int* out_len)
functions.description: Returns the number of evaluation metrics configured for the booster.
requirements: handle must be valid.
out_len must be non-NULL.
Returns 0 on success, -1 on failure.

functions.name: LGBM_BoosterGetEvalNames
functions.signature: LIGHTGBM_C_EXPORT int LGBM_BoosterGetEvalNames(BoosterHandle handle, const int len, int* out_len, const size_t buffer_len, size_t* out_buffer_len, char** out_strs)
functions.description: Returns the names of evaluation metrics. Copies up to len names into provided buffers of size buffer_len each and reports required sizes.
requirements: handle must be valid.
out_len must be non-NULL to receive total count.
out_strs must point to an array of len pre-allocated char* buffers; each must have at least buffer_len bytes.
out_buffer_len must point to an array to receive required sizes for full copies.
If len is smaller than total, only len names are copied.
Returns 0 on success, -1 on failure.

functions.name: LGBM_BoosterGetFeatureNames
functions.signature: LIGHTGBM_C_EXPORT int LGBM_BoosterGetFeatureNames(BoosterHandle handle, const int len, int* out_len, const size_t buffer_len, size_t* out_buffer_len, char** out_strs)
functions.description: Retrieves feature names associated with the booster’s training data. Copies up to len names into provided buffers and reports required sizes.
requirements: handle must be valid.
out_len must be non-NULL to receive total feature count.
out_strs must point to an array of len pre-allocated char* buffers with buffer_len each; strings are null-terminated up to buffer_len-1.
out_buffer_len must point to an array to receive required sizes for each name.
Returns 0 on success, -1 on failure.

functions.name: LGBM_BoosterValidateFeatureNames
functions.signature: LIGHTGBM_C_EXPORT int LGBM_BoosterValidateFeatureNames(BoosterHandle handle, const char** data_names, int data_num_features)
functions.description: Checks that provided feature names and count match those used to train the booster.
requirements: handle must be valid.
data_names must point to an array of data_num_features C strings.
data_num_features must equal the model’s feature count and names must match in order for validation to pass.
Returns 0 on success, -1 on failure.

functions.name: LGBM_BoosterGetNumFeature
functions.signature: LIGHTGBM_C_EXPORT int LGBM_BoosterGetNumFeature(BoosterHandle handle, int* out_len)
functions.description: Returns the number of features expected by the booster.
requirements: handle must be valid.
out_len must be non-NULL.
Returns 0 on success, -1 on failure.

functions.name: LGBM_BoosterGetEval
functions.signature: LIGHTGBM_C_EXPORT int LGBM_BoosterGetEval(BoosterHandle handle, int data_idx, int* out_len, double* out_results)
functions.description: Gets evaluation metric values for training/validation datasets at the current iteration.
requirements: handle must be valid.
data_idx: 0 for training data, 1 for first validation, etc.; must be in range of added datasets.
out_len must be non-NULL; equals number of metrics.
out_results must be pre-allocated with space for number of metrics (from LGBM_BoosterGetEvalCounts).
Call LGBM_BoosterGetEvalNames first to map indices to names.
Returns 0 on success, -1 on failure.

functions.name: LGBM_BoosterGetNumPredict
functions.signature: LIGHTGBM_C_EXPORT int LGBM_BoosterGetNumPredict(BoosterHandle handle, int data_idx, int64_t* out_len)
functions.description: Returns the number of predictions that would be produced for the specified internal dataset (train/validation).
requirements: handle must be valid.
data_idx: 0 for training, 1+ for validations; must be in range.
out_len must be non-NULL to receive count.
Returns 0 on success, -1 on failure.

functions.name: LGBM_BoosterGetPredict
functions.signature: LIGHTGBM_C_EXPORT int LGBM_BoosterGetPredict(BoosterHandle handle, int data_idx, int64_t* out_len, double* out_result)
functions.description: Gets predictions for an internal dataset (train/validation).
requirements: handle must be valid.
data_idx must reference an attached dataset (0 for training, then validations).
out_len must be non-NULL; equals number of predictions (num_class * num_data).
out_result must be pre-allocated with at least out_len doubles.
Returns 0 on success, -1 on failure.

functions.name: LGBM_BoosterPredictForFile
functions.signature: LIGHTGBM_C_EXPORT int LGBM_BoosterPredictForFile(BoosterHandle handle, const char* data_filename, int data_has_header, int predict_type, int start_iteration, int num_iteration, const char* parameter, const char* result_filename)
functions.description: Runs prediction on a dataset loaded from a file and writes predictions to an output file.
requirements: handle must be valid.
data_filename must be a readable data file; data_has_header indicates header presence (0/1).
predict_type must be one of C_API_PREDICT_NORMAL/RAW_SCORE/LEAF_INDEX/CONTRIB.
start_iteration >= 0; num_iteration <= 0 means no limit.
parameter is an optional parameter string for prediction options (e.g., early stopping).
result_filename must be a writable file path.
Returns 0 on success, -1 on failure.

functions.name: LGBM_BoosterCalcNumPredict
functions.signature: LIGHTGBM_C_EXPORT int LGBM_BoosterCalcNumPredict(BoosterHandle handle, int num_row, int predict_type, int start_iteration, int num_iteration, int64_t* out_len)
functions.description: Calculates how many prediction values will be produced for given number of rows and settings (useful to size output buffers).
requirements: handle must be valid.
num_row >= 0.
predict_type must be one of C_API_PREDICT_NORMAL/RAW_SCORE/LEAF_INDEX/CONTRIB.
start_iteration >= 0; num_iteration <= 0 means no limit.
out_len must be non-NULL.
Returns 0 on success, -1 on failure.

functions.name: LGBM_FastConfigFree
functions.description: Releases a FastConfig object obtained from FastInit APIs used for single-row fast prediction.
requirements: fastConfig must be a valid FastConfigHandle returned by a FastInit function.
Do not use the handle after freeing it.
Returns 0 on success, -1 on failure.

functions.name: LGBM_BoosterPredictForCSR
functions.signature: LIGHTGBM_C_EXPORT int LGBM_BoosterPredictForCSR(BoosterHandle handle, const void* indptr, int indptr_type, const int32_t* indices, const void* data, int data_type, int64_t nindptr, int64_t nelem, int64_t num_col, int predict_type, int start_iteration, int num_iteration, const char* parameter, int64_t* out_len, double* out_result)
functions.description: Runs prediction on a CSR sparse matrix.
requirements: handle must be valid.
indptr length nindptr with type per indptr_type (C_API_DTYPE_INT32/INT64).
indices/data length nelem; indices in [0, num_col). data type per data_type (C_API_DTYPE_FLOAT32/FLOAT64).
nindptr = num_rows + 1; num_col >= 0.
predict_type one of NORMAL/RAW_SCORE/LEAF_INDEX/CONTRIB; start_iteration >= 0; num_iteration <= 0 means no limit.
parameter optional string for prediction options.
out_len must be non-NULL; out_result must be pre-allocated with size documented per predict_type.
Returns 0 on success, -1 on failure.

functions.name: LGBM_BoosterPredictSparseOutput
functions.signature: LIGHTGBM_C_EXPORT int LGBM_BoosterPredictSparseOutput(BoosterHandle handle, const void* indptr, int indptr_type, const int32_t* indices, const void* data, int data_type, int64_t nindptr, int64_t nelem, int64_t num_col_or_row, int predict_type, int start_iteration, int num_iteration, const char* parameter, int matrix_type, int64_t* out_len, void** out_indptr, int32_t** out_indices, void** out_data)
functions.description: Produces sparse prediction output (currently for SHAP feature contributions) in CSR or CSC form matching the input sparse orientation. Allocates output sparse buffers which must be freed with LGBM_BoosterFreePredictSparse.
requirements: handle must be valid.
Input matrix must be provided in CSR or CSC form: indptr (int32/int64 per indptr_type), indices (int32), data of type per data_type; lengths nindptr and nelem consistent.
num_col_or_row is number of columns for CSR or number of rows for CSC; must be consistent with indices.
predict_type currently only supports C_API_PREDICT_CONTRIB.
start_iteration >= 0; num_iteration <= 0 means no limit; parameter optional.
matrix_type must be C_API_MATRIX_TYPE_CSR or C_API_MATRIX_TYPE_CSC and determines output orientation; output indptr_type matches input indptr_type.

out_len must be non-NULL (expects to receive lengths of output data and indptr via a two-entry array per comment); out_indptr, out_indices, out_data must be non-NULL pointers to receive allocated arrays.
Caller must free outputs using LGBM_BoosterFreePredictSparse with matching indptr_type and data_type.
Returns 0 on success, -1 on failure.

functions.name: LGBM_BoosterFreePredictSparse
functions.signature: LIGHTGBM_C_EXPORT int LGBM_BoosterFreePredictSparse(void* indptr, int32_t* indices, void* data, int indptr_type, int data_type)
functions.description: Frees memory allocated by LGBM_BoosterPredictSparseOutput for sparse prediction results.
requirements: indptr, indices, data must be pointers previously returned by LGBM_BoosterPredictSparseOutput.
indptr_type must match the type used to allocate indptr (C_API_DTYPE_INT32/INT64).
data_type must match the type used to allocate data (C_API_DTYPE_FLOAT32/FLOAT64).
Returns 0 on success, -1 on failure.

functions.name: LGBM_BoosterPredictForCSRSingleRow
functions.signature: LIGHTGBM_C_EXPORT int LGBM_BoosterPredictForCSRSingleRow(BoosterHandle handle, const void* indptr, int indptr_type, const int32_t* indices, const void* data, int data_type, int64_t nindptr, int64_t nelem, int64_t num_col, int predict_type, int start_iteration, int num_iteration, const char* parameter, int64_t* out_len, double* out_result)
functions.description: Runs prediction for a CSR-formatted input optimized for single-row invocation by reusing internal predictor structures across calls.
requirements: handle must be valid.
CSR inputs follow the same rules as LGBM_BoosterPredictForCSR; nindptr should be 2 for a single row.
predict_type/start_iteration/num_iteration/parameter as in standard predict.
out_len non-NULL; out_result pre-allocated sized per predict_type for a single row.
Returns 0 on success, -1 on failure.

functions.name: LGBM_BoosterPredictForCSRSingleRowFastInit
functions.signature: LIGHTGBM_C_EXPORT int LGBM_BoosterPredictForCSRSingleRowFastInit(BoosterHandle handle, const int predict_type, const int start_iteration, const int num_iteration, const int data_type, const int64_t num_col, const char* parameter, FastConfigHandle *out_fastConfig)
functions.description: Initializes and returns a FastConfig used to accelerate repeated single-row CSR predictions by hoisting setup work out of the prediction loop.
requirements: handle must be valid.
predict_type must be one of NORMAL/RAW_SCORE/LEAF_INDEX/CONTRIB.
start_iteration >= 0; num_iteration <= 0 means no limit.
data_type is C_API_DTYPE_FLOAT32 or C_API_DTYPE_FLOAT64 and must match data used in Fast predictions.
num_col must match the number of features in subsequent single-row data.
parameter optional string for prediction options.
out_fastConfig must be non-NULL; free later with LGBM_FastConfigFree.
Returns 0 on success, -1 on failure.

functions.name: LGBM_BoosterPredictForCSRSingleRowFast
functions.signature: LIGHTGBM_C_EXPORT int LGBM_BoosterPredictForCSRSingleRowFast(FastConfigHandle fastConfig_handle, const void* indptr, const int indptr_type, const int32_t* indices, const void* data, const int64_t nindptr, const int64_t nelem, int64_t* out_len, double* out_result)
functions.description: Runs faster single-row CSR prediction using a FastConfig created by the corresponding FastInit, avoiding repeated setup and thread configuration.
requirements: fastConfig_handle must be a valid FastConfigHandle from LGBM_BoosterPredictForCSRSingleRowFastInit and must match data_type/num_col/predict settings used during init.
CSR inputs must describe a single row: nindptr == 2; indptr_type matches what predictor expects; indices length nelem; indices within [0, num_col).
out_len must be non-NULL; out_result must be pre-allocated sized per predict_type for a single row.
If thread settings change elsewhere, re-run FastInit as noted in documentation.
Returns 0 on success, -1 on failure.

functions.name: LGBM_BoosterPredictForCSC
functions.signature: LIGHTGBM_C_EXPORT int LGBM_BoosterPredictForCSC(BoosterHandle handle, const void* col_ptr, int col_ptr_type, const int32_t* indices, const void* data, int data_type, int64_t ncol_ptr, int64_t nelem, int64_t num_row, int predict_type, int start_iteration, int num_iteration, const char* parameter, int64_t* out_len, double* out_result)
functions.description: Runs prediction on a CSC sparse matrix.
requirements: handle must be valid.
col_ptr length ncol_ptr with type per col_ptr_type (C_API_DTYPE_INT32/INT64).
indices/data length nelem; indices in [0, num_row). data type per data_type (C_API_DTYPE_FLOAT32/FLOAT64).
ncol_ptr = num_cols + 1; num_row >= 0.
predict_type/start_iteration/num_iteration/parameter as in other predict APIs.
out_len non-NULL; out_result pre-allocated sized per predict_type.
Returns 0 on success, -1 on failure.

functions.name: LGBM_BoosterPredictForMat
functions.signature: LIGHTGBM_C_EXPORT int LGBM_BoosterPredictForMat(BoosterHandle handle, const void* data, int data_type, int32_t nrow, int32_t ncol, int is_row_major, int predict_type, int start_iteration, int num_iteration, const char* parameter, int64_t* out_len, double* out_result)
functions.description: Runs prediction on a dense matrix in row- or column-major layout.
requirements: handle must be valid.
data must point to a dense array with element type per data_type (C_API_DTYPE_FLOAT32/FLOAT64).
nrow >= 0; ncol >= 0; is_row_major 1 for row-major, 0 for column-major.
predict_type/start_iteration/num_iteration/parameter as documented.
out_len non-NULL; out_result pre-allocated sized per predict_type.
Returns 0 on success, -1 on failure.

functions.name: LGBM_BoosterPredictForMatSingleRow
functions.signature: LIGHTGBM_C_EXPORT int LGBM_BoosterPredictForMatSingleRow(BoosterHandle handle, const void* data, int data_type, int ncol, int is_row_major, int predict_type, int start_iteration, int num_iteration, const char* parameter, int64_t* out_len, double* out_result)
functions.description: Runs prediction optimized for a single dense row, reusing internal predictor setup between calls.
requirements: handle must be valid.
data points to a single row with element type per data_type; ncol must equal number of features.
is_row_major must reflect layout (for a single row, row-major is typical).
predict_type/start_iteration/num_iteration/parameter as documented.
out_len non-NULL; out_result pre-allocated sized per predict_type for one row.
Returns 0 on success, -1 on failure.

functions.name: LGBM_BoosterPredictForMatSingleRowFastInit
functions.signature: LIGHTGBM_C_EXPORT int LGBM_BoosterPredictForMatSingleRowFastInit(BoosterHandle handle, const int predict_type, const int start_iteration, const int num_iteration, const int data_type, const int32_t ncol, const char* parameter, FastConfigHandle *out_fastConfig)
functions.description: Initializes a FastConfig for repeated single-row dense predictions, enabling faster subsequent calls.
requirements: handle must be valid.
predict_type must be NORMAL/RAW_SCORE/LEAF_INDEX/CONTRIB; start_iteration >= 0; num_iteration <= 0 means no limit.
data_type must be C_API_DTYPE_FLOAT32 or C_API_DTYPE_FLOAT64 and match later data.
ncol must match feature count in later predictions.
parameter optional string.
out_fastConfig must be non-NULL; free with LGBM_FastConfigFree.
Returns 0 on success, -1 on failure.

functions.name: LGBM_BoosterPredictForMatSingleRowFast
functions.signature: LIGHTGBM_C_EXPORT int LGBM_BoosterPredictForMatSingleRowFast(FastConfigHandle fastConfig_handle, const void* data, int64_t* out_len, double* out_result)
functions.description: Runs faster single-row dense prediction using a previously initialized FastConfig.
requirements: fastConfig_handle must be valid from LGBM_BoosterPredictForMatSingleRowFastInit and match predict/data_type/ncol settings.
data must point to a single row with element type matching the FastConfig.
out_len must be non-NULL; out_result must be pre-allocated sized per predict_type for one row.
If thread settings change elsewhere, reinitialize FastConfig.
Returns 0 on success, -1 on failure.

functions.name: LGBM_BoosterPredictForMats
functions.signature: LIGHTGBM_C_EXPORT int LGBM_BoosterPredictForMats(BoosterHandle handle, const void** data, int data_type, int32_t nrow, int32_t ncol, int predict_type, int start_iteration, int num_iteration, const char* parameter, int64_t* out_len, double* out_result)
functions.description: Runs prediction for an array of pointers to rows (array-of-rows dense input).
requirements: handle must be valid.
data must point to an array of nrow pointers, each pointing to a dense row with ncol entries of type per data_type (C_API_DTYPE_FLOAT32/FLOAT64).
nrow >= 0; ncol >= 0.
predict_type/start_iteration/num_iteration/parameter as documented.
out_len non-NULL; out_result pre-allocated sized per predict_type.
Returns 0 on success, -1 on failure.

functions.name: LGBM_BoosterPredictForArrow
functions.signature: LIGHTGBM_C_EXPORT int LGBM_BoosterPredictForArrow(BoosterHandle handle, int64_t n_chunks, const struct ArrowArray* chunks, const struct ArrowSchema* schema, int predict_type, int start_iteration, int num_iteration, const char* parameter, int64_t* out_len, double* out_result)
functions.description: Runs prediction on data provided as Apache Arrow arrays with a shared schema.
requirements: handle must be valid.
n_chunks >= 0; chunks must point to n_chunks ArrowArray; schema must be compatible with chunks and model.
predict_type/start_iteration/num_iteration/parameter as documented.
out_len non-NULL; out_result pre-allocated sized per predict_type.
Arrow buffers must remain valid during prediction as required by implementation.
Returns 0 on success, -1 on failure.

functions.name: LGBM_BoosterSaveModel
functions.signature: LIGHTGBM_C_EXPORT int LGBM_BoosterSaveModel(BoosterHandle handle, int start_iteration, int num_iteration, int feature_importance_type, const char* filename)
functions.description: Saves the model to a file, optionally limiting to a slice of iterations and selecting the feature importance type to include.
requirements: handle must be valid.
start_iteration >= 0; num_iteration <= 0 means save all iterations.
feature_importance_type must be C_API_FEATURE_IMPORTANCE_SPLIT or C_API_FEATURE_IMPORTANCE_GAIN.
filename must be a writable path.
Returns 0 on success, -1 on failure.

functions.name: LGBM_BoosterSaveModelToString
functions.signature: LIGHTGBM_C_EXPORT int LGBM_BoosterSaveModelToString(BoosterHandle handle, int start_iteration, int num_iteration, int feature_importance_type, int64_t buffer_len, int64_t* out_len, char* out_str)
functions.description: Serializes the model to a string buffer with options for iteration range and feature importance type.
requirements: handle must be valid.
start_iteration >= 0; num_iteration <= 0 means all.
feature_importance_type must be SPLIT or GAIN.
out_len must be non-NULL to receive actual size.
out_str must have at least buffer_len bytes if buffer_len > 0; if buffer_len < *out_len, re-allocate and call again.
Returns 0 on success, -1 on failure.

functions.name: LGBM_BoosterDumpModel
functions.signature: LIGHTGBM_C_EXPORT int LGBM_BoosterDumpModel(BoosterHandle handle, int start_iteration, int num_iteration, int feature_importance_type, int64_t buffer_len, int64_t* out_len, char* out_str)
functions.description: Dumps the model to a JSON string including structure and feature importance.
requirements: handle must be valid.
start_iteration >= 0; num_iteration <= 0 means all.
feature_importance_type must be SPLIT or GAIN.
out_len must be non-NULL; out_str must have at least buffer_len bytes if buffer_len > 0; if buffer_len < *out_len, re-allocate and retry.
Returns 0 on success, -1 on failure.

functions.name: LGBM_BoosterGetLeafValue
functions.signature: LIGHTGBM_C_EXPORT int LGBM_BoosterGetLeafValue(BoosterHandle handle, int tree_idx, int leaf_idx, double* out_val)
functions.description: Gets the value stored at a given leaf in a specified tree.
requirements: handle must be valid.
tree_idx and leaf_idx must reference existing tree and leaf indices.
out_val must be non-NULL to receive the value.
Returns 0 on success, -1 on failure.

functions.name: LGBM_BoosterSetLeafValue
functions.signature: LIGHTGBM_C_EXPORT int LGBM_BoosterSetLeafValue(BoosterHandle handle, int tree_idx, int leaf_idx, double val)
functions.description: Sets the value at a specific leaf in a specified tree.
requirements: handle must be valid.
tree_idx and leaf_idx must reference an existing leaf.
val is the new leaf value; caller ensures it is sensible for the model.
Returns 0 on success, -1 on failure.

functions.name: LGBM_BoosterFeatureImportance
functions.signature: LIGHTGBM_C_EXPORT int LGBM_BoosterFeatureImportance(BoosterHandle handle, int num_iteration, int importance_type, double* out_results)
functions.description: Computes feature importance for the model across a given number of iterations using either split counts or gain.
requirements: handle must be valid.
num_iteration <= 0 means use all iterations; otherwise must be within model range.
importance_type must be C_API_FEATURE_IMPORTANCE_SPLIT or C_API_FEATURE_IMPORTANCE_GAIN.
out_results must point to a pre-allocated array of length equal to number of features.
Returns 0 on success, -1 on failure.

functions.name: LGBM_BoosterGetUpperBoundValue
functions.description: Retrieves the model’s upper bound value for predictions, if defined by the objective/constraints.
requirements: handle must be valid.
out_results must be non-NULL to receive the value.
Returns 0 on success, -1 on failure.

functions.name: LGBM_BoosterGetLowerBoundValue
functions.description: Retrieves the model’s lower bound value for predictions, if defined by the objective/constraints.
requirements: handle must be valid.
out_results must be non-NULL to receive the value.
Returns 0 on success, -1 on failure.

functions.name: LGBM_NetworkInit
functions.signature: LIGHTGBM_C_EXPORT int LGBM_NetworkInit(const char* machines, int local_listen_port, int listen_time_out, int num_machines)
functions.description: Initializes LightGBM’s internal network for distributed training using a list of machines.
requirements: machines must be a string like 'ip1:port1,ip2:port2' describing all nodes.
local_listen_port is the TCP port used locally; must be available.
listen_time_out is socket timeout in minutes; positive integer per environment.
num_machines must match the number of entries in machines.
Returns 0 on success, -1 on failure.

functions.name: LGBM_NetworkFree
functions.description: Finalizes and frees resources associated with the LightGBM networking layer.
requirements: Call only after successful LGBM_NetworkInit or LGBM_NetworkInitWithFunctions.
No parameters; returns 0 on success, -1 on failure.

functions.name: LGBM_NetworkInitWithFunctions
functions.signature: LIGHTGBM_C_EXPORT int LGBM_NetworkInitWithFunctions(int num_machines, int rank, void* reduce_scatter_ext_fun, void* allgather_ext_fun)
functions.description: Initializes distributed networking using externally provided collective communication functions for reduce-scatter and allgather.
requirements: num_machines >= 1; rank in [0, num_machines-1].
reduce_scatter_ext_fun and allgather_ext_fun must be valid function pointers matching LightGBM’s expected signatures (opaque here).
Use instead of LGBM_NetworkInit when integrating with external comm libraries.
Returns 0 on success, -1 on failure.

functions.name: LGBM_SetMaxThreads
functions.description: Sets the maximum number of threads used by LightGBM routines in this process.
requirements: num_threads is the cap on threads; -1 means default to omp_get_num_threads().
Affects subsequent operations in the process; returns 0 on success, -1 on failure.

functions.name: LGBM_GetMaxThreads
functions.description: Gets the current maximum number of threads used by LightGBM in this process.
requirements: out must be non-NULL to receive the thread cap; -1 means default to omp_get_num_threads().
Returns 0 on success, -1 on failure.

functions.name: LGBM_SetLastError
functions.description: Sets the thread-local last error message string used by LGBM_GetLastError. Primarily for internal use; it formats/copies msg into a fixed-size buffer.
requirements: msg must be a valid null-terminated C string.
The internal buffer is fixed at 512 bytes; message is truncated to fit.
Safe use across C standards varies: may use snprintf or sprintf per compile-time conditions.
No return value; do not rely on this unless integrating within LightGBM internals.
